cause_quote: The new pre-command engine selection added `if (isConfigReadFailure(snapshot) || ...) { throw createConfigReadError(snapshot); }`, throwing the read failure unprinted before the config guard (which printed the heading, file and issues) could run, so the root printer showed only the generic line and Doctor hint.
user_saw: With an unreadable config (for example a missing include), `openclaw status` and `openclaw doctor` printed only "The CLI command failed." and told the user to run `openclaw doctor`, which failed the same way.
summary: The root CLI failure printer now shows the redacted config-read reason, without the Doctor hint, for errors with code CONFIG_READ_FAILED.
reasoning: Before 0636e552396 (#175069, CLI engine selection for PostgreSQL), config read failures reached src/cli/program/config-guard.ts, which printed the failure heading, file path and issues via runtime.error before throwing; I confirmed that code at 0636e552396^. #175069 added an earlier read in src/cli/database-engine-selection.ts that throws createConfigReadError unprinted, and the root printer (terse since #163381) drops the reason; #175677 later restored details only for invalid configs, leaving read failures broken until this fix.
